token_summation: assistant new tokens only (chat template); prompt tokens excluded

logprob_convention.primary: sum of log softmax(logits / T) over generated tokens (sampling distribution at temperature T, top_p=1.0)
logprob_convention.secondary: sum of log softmax(logits) over generated tokens (model distribution, T=1)
logprob_convention.greedy: p_max=1 by construction; the model-distribution probability of the greedy response is also reported

estimator_bias: p_max_est = max over N sampled sequences of exp(logprob) is a LOWER bound on the true mode probability (the mode may not be sampled).
k_est = -log2(p_max_est) is therefore an UPPER bound on the true k.
E1's empirical k = log2(N) when all samples are unique is a sampling-resolution cap, NOT a lower bound on the true k; the only strict one-sided statement is k_true <= k_est.
Sequence logprob sums over tokens and shrinks with length; compare per-token mean logprob across prompts, not raw sums.
This estimates the probability of the EXACT token string, not of a semantic cluster.
